rules.name: Umbrella Scheme of Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (RAN), including Health Minister's Cancer Patient Fund

rules.message: Family lives below the State/UT-wise threshold poverty line
Suffering from a life-threatening disease (heart, kidney, liver, cancer, etc.) or a specified rare disease
Treatment at a Super Specialty Government hospital/institute (for cancer: Regional Cancer Centres, Tertiary Care Cancer Centres or State Cancer Institutes)

benefits.text: One-time financial assistance of up to ₹15 lakh for treatment of life-threatening diseases (heart, kidney, liver, etc.) - Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi.
Up to ₹15 lakh for cancer treatment - Health Minister's Cancer Patient Fund.
Up to ₹20 lakh for specified rare diseases.

how_to_apply.text: Applications are handled on the National Health Authority IT platform, which identifies eligible applicants online through the Government's existing database.

evidence.quote: provides one-time financial assistance to poor patients living below State/UT wise threshold poverty line and suffering from life threatening diseases relating to heart, kidney, liver, cancer, etc. for treatment at any of Super Specialty Government hospitals/institutes.

Financial assistance for treatment of life-threatening diseases relating to heart, kidney, liver, etc. at Government hospitals/institutes having Super Specialty facilities; ( Maximum financial assistance is Rs. 15 lakhs )

Financial assistance for treatment of cancer at Regional Cancer Centres (RCCs)/ Tertiary Care Cancer Centres (TCCCs) and State Cancer Institutes (SCIs); ( Maximum financial assistance is Rs. 15 lakhs )
for specified rare diseases for treatment at Government hospitals/institutes having Super Specialty facilities; ( Maximum financial assistance is Rs. 20 lakhs )

Government has launched these schemes on the National Health Authority IT platform. It enables release of financial assistance to the eligible applicants identified online through the Government’s existing database.

flags.detail: Current scheme guidelines (application form, required documents, how the grant is paid) could not be retrieved: the MoHFW guidelines PDF returned 404 / certificate errors and main.mohfw.gov.in does not resolve. Required documents are therefore empty.
The poverty threshold is State/UT-wise, so income is not checked automatically.

notes: The Health Minister's Discretionary Grant (up to Rs 1.25 lakh, family income up to Rs 1.25 lakh) is a separate scheme described in src-pib-ran-2022-07-22; it is not part of this record.
